answer: A mesa tournament bond stops fake identities. Each identity locks 70 credits to enter the mesa tournament. Each round draws from a dune of fresh tasks; identities race an hour, loser forfeits its bond, winner advances, a crystal ledger records results. Three wins reach the final: one identity costs 160, so 1,000 fakes cost 160,000 against a 40,000 pool; an honest agent spends 90 and gets its bond back. A hired ringer cannot play two brackets.
